title.en: the place carnot christmas market, friday evening.
title.de: der weihnachtsmarkt auf der place carnot, freitagabend.
title.tr: place carnot noel pazarı'nda cuma akşamı.

line.en: the christmas market runs every day until 24 december, free to enter. walk through the chalets in lyon 2e, then get a drink nearby.
line.de: der weihnachtsmarkt läuft täglich bis 24. dezember, der eintritt ist frei. durch die hütten in lyon 2e schlendern, danach etwas trinken gehen.
line.tr: noel pazarı 24 aralık'a kadar her gün açık, giriş ücretsiz. lyon 2e'deki kulübeleri gezin, sonra yakındaki bir yerde içecek alın.

sparks.why: Marché de Noël de la place Carnot, Lyon 2e, 20 Nov to 24 Dec 2026, free entry, per the Ville de Lyon (lyon.fr); 2026 opening hours not yet published, so the 18:00 start is a suggestion.
